name: github-skills
description: Templates for PR descriptions, design docs and GitHub issues, plus a workflow for stacked PRs

plugins.name: github-skills
plugins.description: Templates and style rules for engineering writing on GitHub (pull request descriptions, design docs, bug reports, feature requests, prioritized requests and engineering tickets) and a workflow for stacked pull requests with the gh-stack extension. Use when the user wants to write, fill in or review any of them, add PR and issue templates to a repo, or split work into small dependent PRs.
